read.thesis: Capex raised to $60-64B for 2026 with $100B more Arizona and utilisation rising, but Q3 gross margin guided down to 65-67% on 2nm ramp dilution of 3-4 points.

utilisation.quote: a slightly higher overall capacity utilization rate

capex.peers_comment: Mentions competitor Samsung Foundry and Intel receiving government support; no comment on their capacity additions.
capex.quote: we have decided to raise our full year 2026 capital budget to be between $60 billion and $64 billion

triggers.label: 2026 growth slightly above 40%
triggers.quote: we now expect our full year 2026 revenue growth to be slightly above 40% year-over-year in U.S. dollar terms

triggers.label: Inventory days up 7 to 87

triggers.label: Q3 gross margin guided to 65-67%

triggers.label: Consumer demand challenged
triggers.quote: consumer and the price-sensitive end market segment are being challenged due to the impact of rising component prices

guidance.quote: we expect our third quarter revenue to be between $44.6 billion and $45.8 billion
gross margin is expected to be between 65% and 67%
we now expect our full year 2026 revenue growth to be slightly above 40% year-over-year in U.S. dollar terms
we have decided to raise our full year 2026 capital budget to be between $60 billion and $64 billion
In 2026, they will receive TWD 24 per share, up another 33% year-over-year.
Pre-production will start in 2027, and volume production is scheduled for 2028.
